card.name: Lead-in before patient-group lists
card.fires_on: Words that open a new patient-group item in a risk list, such as 'include' before 'those with', 'or' after a semicolon before 'in patients who', or 'In' before 'patients with'. It fires where the next words are likely 'those' or 'patients'.

modes.label: include before those
modes.description: The verb 'include' after an at-risk patient group, leading into 'those with'.
modes.example: Hypertensive patients at risk of excessive hypotension<< include>> those with the following concurrent conditions or characteristics

modes.label: or between list items
modes.description: 'or' after a semicolon in a list of patient conditions, leading into 'in patients who'.
modes.example: 60 mL/min/1.73 m 2 ; in patients with a history of hepatic impairment, alcoholism, or heart failure;<< or>> in patients who will be administered intra-

modes.label: In opening a patient item
modes.description: 'In' starting a bulleted contraindication or warning about patients.
modes.example: •<< In>> patients with primary or secondary carnitine

card.writes: It promotes words like 'those', 'where' and 'when', which introduce a group or condition.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a warning list where a new group of patients is about to be named.
